title: Madrid Partner Summit — travel & expenses scratchpad
content:
Quick running notes for Madrid Partner Summit (IFEMA) — admin + expense reminders

Objectives/quick wins:
- Set up small demo booth (2m table + monitor) for partner meetings. Keep it light — mostly to demo latency/cost dashboards.
- 3 partner meetings scheduled: Telefónica (Mar 15 14:30), IberCloud (Mar 16 10:00), Local ISP partner intro (Mar 17 11:00). Confirm rooms.

Travel logistics (personal):
- Flights: SFO->MAD via MADAir 3/14 10:45am — confirmation XJ8K3. Return 3/18 9:10am. Checked bag allowed (priority card).
- Hotel: Hotel Catalonia Plaza — reservation under 'Redwood / Jordan Chen' arrival 3/14 checkout 3/18. Room 502 tentative. Early check-in request email sent (Mar 2).
- Airport transfer: Use prebooked shuttle for arrival (vendor: MadridShuttle, booking #MS-992). For local trips, use company card + uber if late.
- Transport note: IFEMA is northeast (take Cercanías C1 from Atocha to Chamartín + bus). Allow 90 mins from city center during morning.

Booth / materials / shipments:
- Small crate with monitor + dongles -> ship via DHL TradeShow. Contact: logistics@dhltradeshow.es, phone +34 91 000 0000. AWB pending — need to finalize by Mar 4 to avoid expedited fees.
- Bring: HDMI cable (2x), USB-C power brick, lightweight banner stand (rolled), business cards (150), spare laptop power cable.
- On-site storage: Ask venue for temporary storage for crate after setup.

Vendor contacts (save in phone):
- AV: SonidoPro / Jose Alvarez — jose@sonidopro.es / +34 612 345 678 (Spanish, English) — confirmed 2x mics + monitor hookup.
- Catering (partner dinners): TapasEventos / Ana Gomez — ana@tapaseventos.es / +34 611 222 333 — final headcount due Mar 9.
- Booth freight / customs broker: IberiaFreight / broker@iberiafreight.es / +34 915 555 444 — watch HS code for electronics; they need invoice + packing list.
- Local partner contact: Lucía Ramos (Telefónica partner ops) lucia.ramos@telefonica.es / +34 600 123 456 (meet in Hall 4).

Speaker / meeting prep:
- 20-min partner demo + 10 min Q&A. Slide deck version for offline (PDF) + live demo credentials (demo/redwood-demo). Bring fallback recorded demo.
- Dry run: Mar 15 12:30 — test AV and screen-sharing with Jose on-site.

Expense / receipts rules & to-dos (Concur workflow reminders):
- Per diem cap: 60 EUR/day (meals & incidental). Any single meal >60 EUR needs itemized receipt + justification.
- Card policy: Use Redwood corporate card (ending 7342) for vendor payments and dinners where possible. Personal card for incidental/taxis to be reimbursed.
- Receipts: Photograph receipts immediately. Upload to Concur within 7 business days of expense. Name receipts: "MAD-YYYYMMDD-merchant-amount".
- Taxi/Uber: Save trip receipts (export from app). If a single ride >40 EUR, add note with reason and approval (e.g., late-night flight).
- International CC fees: Save bank FX fee line item for reimbursement (category: foreign-transaction-fee).
- VAT: For vendor invoices with VAT (IVA), collect full invoice with VAT number — finance may reclaim for business expenses. Add vendor VAT number to the invoice before submitting.
- Expense categories to use in Concur: travel.airfare, travel.lodging, travel.local-transit, meals.client, meals.personal, equipment-supplies (for booth consumables).
- Concur draft: start expense report "MAD Partner Summit 2026 - Jordan Chen" (TKT-45821). Link receipts to each line.

Reimbursement quick checklist:
- All receipts scanned and named
- Itemized invoices for catering and AV attached
- Currency conversion: use day-of expense FX rate (Concur auto) — note manual conversions if using cash.
- Submit report within 14 days of return to keep AP timeline.

On-site admin nitpicks / reminders:
- Badge pickup: Bring passport or EU ID — pick up for team at exhibitor desk (arrive 60–90 mins early on first day).
- Power strips: venue-provided power limited; bring a 6-outlet strip with surge protector.
- WiFi: venue login can be flaky — have hotspot ready (MiFi with EU SIM or tether).
- Emergency contact for Redwood: Maya Singh (mobile +1 415 555 0199) — cover for Jordan if travel delayed.

Open questions / follow-ups (TODOs):
- [ ] Confirm DHL AWB and customs docs with IberiaFreight by Mar 4.
- [ ] Finalize catering headcount with Ana by Mar 9.
- [ ] Verify demo credentials and remote access with infra by Mar 10 (Evan).
- [ ] Upload policy-compliant VAT invoices or vendor tax id for DPO review.
- [ ] Register final attendee list for partner dinner (Maya).

Notes to self (messy):
- If we need to downsize booth last minute, keep monitor as primary demo device and switch to laptop-only demo.
- Keep one spare business card stash in jacket pocket for impromptu intros.
- Collect 2–3 photos of booth each morning for comms and spend justification.

Small expense scenarios (examples to reference when submitting):
- Taxi from airport -> hotel (35 EUR) -> category: travel.local-transit -> attach photo receipt + airport signage (if disputes).
- Dinner w/ Telefónica rep (Mar 15) 120 EUR -> split: meals.client 120 EUR + note attendees and topics + attach itemized receipt.
- AV technician overtime (if necessary) -> vendor invoice + contact Jose to add overtime line item.

End notes: keep this doc as the working source for receipts and small notes. After trip, consolidate to Confluence page under /partners/events/madrid-2026 (will link once post-trip write-up is created).
